patterns.note: Asymmetric content presentation where large, impactful images often occupy a significant portion of the screen, balanced by expansive whitespace.
Minimalist, all-caps sans-serif typography is used for all functional text (navigation, company info), creating a stark, utilitarian contrast to the visual content.
High-contrast color scheme featuring deep dark tones for the initial hero and text, juxtaposed with vast white content areas, accented by a single bright yellow for interactive elements.

The header remains fixed at the top of the viewport, while the initial full-bleed hero image scrolls up to reveal a large, empty white space, followed by content sections that simply appear as they enter the viewport.
Content is structured with a prominent full-bleed hero followed by sections dominated by large, singular images and significant negative space, rather than dense text blocks or complex layouts.

technique_notes: The header is implemented as a sticky element, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.

The initial hero section is designed to scroll out of view, revealing a substantial amount of empty space before subsequent content sections become visible, creating a dramatic sense of reveal and spaciousness.

Content sections are revealed using a simple scroll-triggered appearance, where elements become visible as they enter the viewport from the bottom, without complex animations beyond their initial display.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, all-uppercase sans-serif text is used for all functional and informational elements, creating a minimal and stark typographic presence.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy; the initial scroll reveals a vast expanse of empty space, and subsequent content sections maintain generous padding and margins.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its extreme commitment to negative space and minimalist text, creating a stark, almost brutalist aesthetic that prioritizes large-scale, impactful imagery and a sense of quiet authority. The initial scroll revealing a vast expanse of white before any substantial content appears is particularly striking and sets a unique tone.
